findings.evidence: The supported-on-components node has seven API entries; its final three are the three names above. The corresponding signatures are at suggested/DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra--R03.6.lean:166,173,178; none of the names occurs in the reader. PROTOCOL section 8 requires that the roadmap reader gives the named declarations with their API and agrees with the packet. For the two compatibility/examples, the actual pinned declarations Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Maps.lean:892 and :901 at 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174 state respectively "Module.annihilator R M = ⊥ ↔ FaithfulSMul R M" and "annihilator R M = ⊤ ↔ Subsingleton M".
